attchmntText: Cohance Lifesciences Limited has informed the Exchange about Investor Presentation
voiceSummary: Cohance Lifesciences Limited filed a revised investor presentation for Q2 and H1 FY27 on 7 November 2026. The update includes corrections and alignments for consistency. Q2 FY27 revenue was INR 4,767 Mn, a 14.2% year-on-year decline but a 12.9% sequential increase. Adjusted EBITDA was INR 458 Mn with a 10% margin. Adjusted PAT was INR 75 Mn. Free cash flow generated was INR 885 Mn. Cash on books stood at INR 2,943 Mn. Net cash position was INR 666 Mn as of 30 September 2026. H2 FY27 revenue and EBITDA are expected to grow year-on-year. The company plans to announce capex investments in adjacencies and R&D.

attchmntText: Cohance Lifesciences Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication
voiceSummary: Cohance Lifesciences Limited filed a notice regarding the publication of newspaper advertisements for its un-audited financial results for the quarter and half year ended 30 September 2026. The advertisements appeared in Business Standard and Lokmat on 07 November 2026. For the quarter ended 30 September 2026, standalone total income was 416.69 Crores with a net loss of 0.26 Crores. Consolidated total income was 476.65 Crores with a net loss of 10.75 Crores. For the half year ended 30 September 2026, standalone net profit was 1.95 Crores. Consolidated net loss was 53.62 Crores. Standalone basic EPS was 0.35 for the quarter and 0.39 for the half year. Consolidated basic EPS was 0.40 for the quarter and negative 0.23 for the half year. The results are hosted on the company website.

attchmntText: Cohance Lifesciences Limited has informed the Exchange about update on USFDA Inspection for Company s Pashamylaram Manufacturing Facility
voiceSummary: Cohance Lifesciences Limited, formerly Suven Pharmaceuticals Limited, has updated the National Stock Exchange and BSE Limited regarding the USFDA inspection at its Pashamylaram, Hyderabad manufacturing facility. The facility's FEI number is 1000623515. The United States Food and Drug Administration has issued the Establishment Inspection Report for this facility. The inspection outcome is classified as Voluntary Action Indicated. This update follows the company's earlier communication dated 5 August 2026. With the receipt of the report, the inspection is concluded. The company requests that this information be taken on record.

attchmntText: Cohance Lifesciences Limited has informed the Exchange about Link of Recording
voiceSummary: Cohance Lifesciences Limited has uploaded the audio recording of the conference call for the quarter and half year ended 30 September 2026. The call was held on Friday, 6 November 2026. The recording is available on the company website at the provided link. This filing follows the results conference call intimation dated 3 November 2026. The company requests the exchanges to take this information on record.
